integrity: One theorem with a necessary-and-sufficient drift classification, rank-one obstruction, Hurwitz corollary, and meshwise implication. Historical priority is qualified by incomplete access to some older monotonicity literature; no independent validation.
limitations: Real finite-dimensional time-invariant Lyapunov equation with constant positive-semidefinite forcing, exact exponential arithmetic and universal all-input/all-step quantifiers. No nonlinear, time-dependent, or roundoff guarantees.
title: Exact Loewner-order frontier for covariance trapezoids in Lyapunov flows
